correctness.rationale: For n>=2 in characteristic two, S_n is cyclic by its endpoint Krylov basis. Its path characteristic polynomial at eigenvalue one has multiplicity m=2^{ν₂(n+1)+1} exactly when 3|(n+1); otherwise 0, from primitive cube-root Laurent substitution and local nonzero derivative. The ladder matrix becomes (u,v)->(Cu,u+Cv) with C=S_n+I. On its zero-primary sector multiplication by t+ε on K[t,ε]/(t^m,ε²) is equivalent to two length-m nilpotent blocks because m is a power of two. Fitting kernel counts give all first-entry shells and the 1−q^-2 last-step fraction. Independent GF(2) rank checks reproduced 208 cases for n=2..30.
